scope: Read-only verification of the retained exact b960 candidate and production data-root behavior; no package mutation or native launch.

dataSafety.finding: The disposable NEANTIK_DEVELOPMENT_DATA_ROOT override is accepted only by the development bundle. The production bundle resolves to ~/Library/Application Support/NeAntik.
dataSafety.candidateFinding: The b960 production app is not the existing build200 Dev QA app and cannot use the Dev fixture-root override.
dataSafety.decision: Do not relaunch the exact production candidate through the real production data root. V252 remains valid historical route evidence and is not repeated.

nextAction: Prepare a private production-mode diagnostic harness with a synthetic data-root capability compiled only into diagnostic bytes, strict root/path/permission checks, exact PID/window/broker/upstream observers, and release-packager rejection of diagnostic mode. Then run one headed isolated test after consumer preflight and fresh native admission; do not change shipped proxy behavior without the resulting evidence.
